💡 Animator | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating explainer videos automatically from text prompts for educational or informational content.
✨ Key Features: • Generates narrated whiteboard explainer videos from text prompts • AI-powered scriptwriting, scene drawing, and narration • Synchronizes animation with spoken narration • Supports custom images and audio for video creation • No GPU required, runs locally on CPU
📖 Summary: Animator is a Python tool that automatically generates narrated, hand-drawn whiteboard explainer videos from a simple text prompt. It leverages AI to write scripts, draw scenes, record narration, and animate elements in sync with the spoken words.
